evaluation.gt: s1051 scoring only after predictions; no fitting; actual camera pitch evaluation only

fit: none; frozen floor/camera/pulse calibration; no GT fitting
method: MER slip-check progress/command ratio, threshold 0.5. Compare signed VO projection onto commanded travel direction against fixed predicted displacement. Complete pure visual pulse only. Preserve measured XY direction and yaw; replace command response only for detected positive slip. No velocity EKF. Missing pairs bridge to last accepted keyframe up to 0.15 s, no command fill or invented zero; incomplete pulse stays unchanged.
covariance: Pixel/fit SE2 covariance propagated by composition; common pitch adds rank-one radial XY scale covariance at pulse level, zero pitch yaw or cross-yaw covariance. Fixed +/-2.8deg known calibration perturbation; no actual camera state. Full covariance retained by S2 predictor; mean direction never changed by scale uncertainty.
full_rule: Only if every gate passes reserve fresh seed/bundle and run one full DEV under agent_lock/ugrp_session/freeze/dev_light. Failure: no physics, summarize v122 onward in one table and stop.
scope: S2-only; own RGB/commands and immutable calibration. No encoders/motor current available: command model substitutes no-slip wheel odometry, detects execution discrepancy not wheel friction uniquely. GT scoring only after replay. Previous EKF/noise options off. Existing Nav2-style recovery remains optional; replay shadow is not actual escape evidence.
